caption: Mole Vanvitelliana, Ancona
composition: Pentagonal harbor lazaretto in the Adriatic basin · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera takes in the Mole Vanvitelliana from across the harbor water in the clear light of the 08:39 morning. The great pentagonal lazaretto fills the center of the frame, its weathered brick ramparts rising straight from the sea, with the small domed church standing on the grassy terrace at its top. Calm Adriatic water surrounds the fortress on three sides, and the green hillside of Ancona with its scattered houses climbs behind it to the right.
